text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time for final race of the Classic
Triple Crown. The audience at Kyoto
Racecourse has high
hopes for the
Kikuka Sho and the mood is festive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the hottest topic of conversation of
all is...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh. So this Air Shakur is pretty strong?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Is she! She's a notch above the others in
her year.
But I guess you could also say
that the others just
aren't up to snuff.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You reckon she'll be able to represent
her whole
year? That's pretty impressive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through consistent training, we've
successfully raised Air Shakur's stats to
meet the parameters
necessary for her to
win the Kikuka Sho. But still...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: I wonder what kind of race it'll b...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The calculations Parcae gave me before
aren't
applicable anymore, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The only thing I can do is keep all the
different
scenarios and variables we ran
simulations of in
mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Like the state of the track, the condition
of my opponents, mid-race
developments... I've memorized about a
hundred combinations to be
safe.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I think that should be enough. It's my
way of
dealin' with the unknown.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
My fate's already changed. I'm not
gonna keep goin' down the path that
was chosen for me. I'm gonna choose the
route that'll lead me to victory for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely find my way there. This
won't be my
last time in the spotlight.
